$comment: Raw QuickBooks data for the newer tabs (Category compare, Group overview, Cash & balance sheet, Budget, Practice KPIs). Every record of these entities is pulled from the QuickBooks Accounting API and stored as-is in qbo_raw; the dashboards are computed from a ledger built out of those records. The first sync of a company pulls full history; later syncs pull only what changed (change data capture), with a full re-pull every fullRefreshDays to be safe. The existing tabs are not affected. Restart the server after editing.
